clauses.scope_note: Agreement to the terms is required to obtain any license under them; it is a condition and strict obligation applicable to all licenses. The listed activities describe the licenses addressed by that condition, not a separate grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: agree_to_license_terms means the licensee agrees to these terms.

clauses.scope_note: Copyright license for the software permits otherwise-copyright-infringing acts with it for a permitted purpose. Distribution is governed separately by the Distribution License, and making changes or new works is governed by the Changes and New Works License. No broader rights are implied.
clauses.condition_explanation: permitted_purpose means a purpose permitted by these terms; the Small Business section identifies one qualifying case, but the text does not define all permitted purposes.

clauses.scope_note: Additional copyright license to distribute copies of the software, including copies with changes and new works only to the extent those changes and new works are permitted by the Changes and New Works License. The Notices section separately imposes conditions when copies are provided.
clauses.condition_explanation: permitted_by_changes_and_new_works_license means the included changes and new works are permitted under that license, including its permitted-purpose limitation.

clauses.scope_note: When the licensee gives anyone a copy of any part of the software, the licensee must ensure the recipient also gets either a copy of these terms or their stated URL, and copies of any plain-text lines beginning “Required Notice:” that the licensor provided with the software. Applies to copies of the software and parts of it, including permitted changes/new works distributed with it.
clauses.condition_explanation: distribution_occurs means the licensee gives someone a copy of any part of the software. recipients_get_license_terms_or_url_and_provided_required_notices requires both the terms-or-URL and all licensor-provided qualifying Required Notice lines.

clauses.scope_note: Additional copyright license to make changes and new works based on the software for any permitted purpose. This is not an unrestricted grant; the terms do not define permitted purpose exhaustively.
clauses.condition_explanation: permitted_purpose means a purpose permitted by these terms; the Small Business section identifies one qualifying case, but the text does not define all permitted purposes.

clauses.scope_note: Patent license for the software, limited to patent claims the licensor can license or becomes able to license and that the licensee would infringe by using the software. The license is subject to the Patent Defense termination provision.
clauses.condition_explanation: patent_claim_licensable_by_licensor_and_would_be_infringed_by_use requires both that the licensor can or becomes able to license the patent claim and that using the software would infringe that claim.

clauses.scope_note: Defines use of the software for the benefit of the licensee’s company as a permitted purpose only if the company has fewer than 100 total employees and independent contractors and prior-tax-year total revenue below the inflation-adjusted USD 1,000,000 (2019) threshold. This identifies a qualifying purpose; it does not itself grant rights beyond the license provisions.
clauses.condition_explanation: company_benefit_use_and_company_below_both_size_and_revenue_thresholds requires use for the company’s benefit, fewer than 100 total employees and independent contractors, and revenue below the stated threshold adjusted using the specified CPI measure.

clauses.scope_note: The terms do not allow the licensee to sublicense any license to anyone else. The same section also says the terms do not allow transfer of licenses and do not imply other licenses; those are not additional activities in the requested activity vocabulary. It preserves the licensor’s ability to license others.

If the licensee makes a written claim that the software infringes or contributes to infringement of any patent, that licensee’s patent license ends immediately. If the licensee’s company makes such a claim, the patent license ends immediately for work on behalf of that company. This terminates patent coverage, rather than prohibiting use under the copyright license.
clauses.condition_explanation: written_patent_infringement_or_contribution_claim_made means the licensee, or the licensee’s company in relation to its work, makes the specified written patent claim; the consequence is immediate loss of the applicable patent license.

clauses.scope_note: On the first written notice of violating any term or doing anything with the software not covered by the licenses, the licenses can continue only if the licensee both comes into full compliance and takes practical steps to correct past violations within 32 days after receiving notice. Otherwise all licenses end immediately. The clause does not state a restoration right for later notices.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is the first written notice of either a violation or unlicensed activity. Both listed cure requirements must be completed within 32 days of receipt; otherwise all licenses end immediately.

coverage_notes: The source is PolyForm Small Business License 1.0.0 text, not evidence of a particular repository, software package, or separately negotiated grant. “Software” is defined as software the licensor makes available under these terms; the clauses apply to that software and, where stated, changes and new works based on it.

The text identifies a company-benefit use as a permitted purpose under the stated small-business thresholds but does not exhaustively define permitted purposes. No unconditional commercial-use, charging, paid-access, hosting/network-service, training, linking, or sale-of-copies grant is stated; silence is not treated as permission.
The notices obligation is triggered by giving someone a copy. No source-code provision, copyleft, or adaptation-sharing obligation is stated in this chunk.

The No Other Rights clause also prohibits transfer of licenses, which is outside the provided activity vocabulary. The patent license is limited as stated and can terminate under Patent Defense; copyright and patent permissions are not interchangeable.

Fair-use language preserves any rights available under law but does not grant a license. Warranty and liability disclaimers and definitions that do not independently alter these activities are omitted.
